notes:
v0.1.16 — adjustable bottom space in terminal:
- New 'Bottom space' slider in the sidebar View section (0–400px, default 80). Reserves empty space below the prompt so the active line no longer sticks to the very bottom edge of the window — easier on the eyes during long sessions.
- Implemented via host-element padding so the terminal fit recomputes fewer rows; setting persists across restarts. Set it to 0 to restore the old edge-to-edge behaviour.
